Two people got into a car accident at the corner today, one of the drivers was a 60-year-old and the other driver a 18 year old. The 18 year old had been going 55mph in a 30mph zone and wasn't able to stop in time to avoid hitting the 60-year-old when he came to a full stop at the stop sign. Who was acting recklessly?
A. Not enough information
B. The 60-year-old
C. The 18 year old
